verdict.rationale: The FAQ documents a 'Usage Data' toggle in Settings that controls sharing of additional non-personal usage data. Diagnostic logs stay on the device unless the user chooses Send feedback. However, the word 'additional' implies a baseline of data collection that cannot be turned off. A community comment citing an exodus-privacy report claims the app tracks location constantly; this is a concern but not a concrete test of the toggle. Missing for 10: a documented way to disable all telemetry, including baseline or required data; clear documentation of what is still collected after opting out; independent verification that the toggle actually stops tracking.
